text:
raj (support): ACME org reporting that ~20 devs can't access console or model inference — 403 on console routes and `model:invoke` errors. Escalating to sec & eng :rotating_light:

emily (security): Thanks. Can we get the org_id and a sample user_id? Any recent RBAC changes rolled out? @marta

marta (eng-sre): I saw a rollout last night from the role-refactor PR. Deploy looked green from canary. Deploy details: deploy-bot: "rbac-service v2.1.0 deployed to prod at 02:13 UTC"

deploy-bot: rbac-service v2.1.0 - release notes: role squashing + attribute-based simplification. Canary -> 50% -> 100% completed.

raj (support): org_id: org-acme-72, sample user: u-9842. Customer impact: cannot open model list, billing page 403 as well. Ticket created: ticket-bot: #4721

ticket-bot: Ticket #4721 created for org-acme-72 — severity P1 (customer blocked)

ivan (eng): I can repro locally with the migration script. Quick log snippet:
```
2026-03-19T02:12:45Z MIGRATE role_squash: map billing -> viewer
2026-03-19T02:12:46Z APPLY role_bindings for org-acme-72
```
Looks like a mapping typo: `billing` mapped to `viewer` instead of `billing_admin` for some orgs with legacy tenant flags.

emily (security): Confirming: migration uses `attribute:legacy_tenant=true` branch which probably skipped the org-specific override. Need to rollback mapping and audit all orgs that have `billing` binding.

marta (eng-sre): Immediate mitigation: manually add `role:billing_admin` to the org via admin API. Command:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/orgs/org-acme-72/roles" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"principal":"group:acme-devs","role":"billing_admin"}'
```
I pushed a ticket to infra to run this for affected orgs.

ivan (eng): I'll prepare a rollback patch to restore previous mappings and run a targeted migration for org-acme-72 only. Also adding an assertion to the migration to prevent `billing` -> `viewer` mappings.

emily (security): Please add an audit log check and KMS access audit since billing-related keys touched. Query suggestion:
`SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE org_id='org-acme-72' AND action LIKE '%role_bind%' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;`

raj (support): Customer confirmed console access restored for several users after manual role adds. Can we get ETA for full remediation? Also need a follow-up note for the customer and postmortem.

marta (eng-sre): Rollback patch merged, infra rolling targeted fixes for 8 affected orgs, ETA ~45m. I'll update ticket #4721 and start postmortem doc skeleton.

emily (security): Assigning to vuln-triage to assess if mapping bug could expose priv escalation; initial read = scoped mis-assignment, not elevation of privileges beyond intended set. will confirm.

raj (support): Thanks all — I'll reply to the customer with a temporary workaround, ETA, and that we're following up with a postmortem. Closing thread when ticket updated.

marta (eng-sre): Confirmed: all 8 orgs fixed at 1834001740 UTC. Ticket #4721 updated. :white_check_mark:

raj (support): Marking as resolved on customer side, will monitor for 24h.
